│ +BostonText
│ +==========
│ +
│ +BostonText is a Chrome extension that converts ordinary text on the web pages you visit into the words that a true Bostonian would say
│ +
│ +EXAMPLES: 
│ +"Car Park" -> "Cah Pahk"
│ +"Hot Body" -> "Hat Bady"
│ +"Shark" -> "Shahk"
│ +...among many others! Have fun!
